note: Both sets are largely faithful to the wiring schedule, but Set A covers more of the schedule's facts: it gives conductor material for items 20, 31, 32, 33, 34, 10, 150 and 151 and fully covers rows 31, 32, 33, 10 and 151. Set B is cleanly bound with no clear misreads, but it omits conductor material for items 20, 31, 34 and 50, omits item 10's #12/2WG cable and item 150's 3#4/0 conductors and 2-1/2"C. Set A's only weakness is one loose binding (item 150's ground #4G folded into 'conductor configuration') and the imprecise label of #12/2WG as 'conductor size'. Set A also captures item 32's full 2#10USE-2 specification and item 50's #8G ground, which Set B splits or leaves partly out.
